prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1212; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the Pearland, Texas scene, I found two vehicles stopped in the travel lanes after a sideswipe collision. Driver 1 stated they were changing lanes when the side of their vehicle made contact with the vehicle operated by Driver 2, who was traveling alongside in the adjacent lane. Driver 2 gave a consistent account, and two independent witnesses on the roadside described the same sequence of events. I photographed both vehicles. The damage is concentrated along the right rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle and the left front fender of Driver 2's vehicle, which is consistent with the lateral impact described. I found no prior damage to either vehicle at the scene. Passenger was seated in the front right position of Driver 1's vehicle and was confirmed by both drivers and the witnesses. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee and was evaluated by EMS on scene. The reported knee injury is plausible given the mechanism of this collision. Driver 1 advised that they live in the same household as the policyholder of the vehicle. No citations were issued at the scene.
